# Replacement blind holdout

The first holdout universal-07–10 failed and is retired to development. Its
original hashes, truth and paid results are preserved, including TWO incorrectly
recovered references. No success is claimed from its later free replay.

Fresh cases replacement-14–16 (9 PDFs) use three independently composed page
structures: vertical property matrices, a two-page sidebar/summary/allocation
form, and parallel label/value columns. The fourth case is the independently
locked, previously uncalled universal-complex set (4 PDFs, two declarations).
All 13 PDFs are synthetic and new; no attachment or retired PDF is edited.

Lock hashes are fixed before the first call. No source changes may be driven
by these replacement results without another retirement. The 4-case total
includes two complex strata (multiple items/containers and multiple declarations),
which are not double counted as additional cases. Original stress11/12 receive
free candidate/evidence checks only under the remaining cumulative call budget.

The user-approved 150-doc/220-request/USD2 limits stay unchanged: after 134/190,
replacement13 + actual final Set3 UI3 consume at most 16 more documents. Repeated
Set2 and original stress paid calls were reallocated to independent holdout.
Set2 still requires saved-response replay and the full existing regressions.

Reproduce with `python generate.py --font=/path/to/Korean-capable.ttf`.
Truth is only for scoring. API request code reads manifest/PDF bytes only.
